instructions: Use this template as the foundation for frontend-only React plus Vite projects.
Do not generate a backend, API proxy, server routes, or /api calls unless the user explicitly asks for a backend.
For public browser-safe APIs, call the public API directly from frontend service modules.
Use the generated preview as the visual contract for frontend layout, copy, color system, and interaction states.
The protected src/main.tsx already imports ./index.css and renders App. Generate src/App.tsx, src/index.css, components, services, types, and tests around that entrypoint.
Do not use Tailwind or utility CSS classes unless Tailwind is explicitly installed and configured. With this template, define every visual class used by JSX in src/index.css.
Do not regenerate protected package/config files unless the user explicitly asks for dependency or config changes.
Generate application code under src and README usage notes at README.md.
